_why: Every proper noun this repo is allowed to contain. Adding a line here is the deliberate act that check-publishable.mjs exists to force: a new capitalised name cannot reach a public repo unless a person put it in this file on purpose. Keep it short. If an entry names a real client, product, programme or person, it does not belong in core at all.
_why_acronyms: Mostly ordinary English words written in capitals inside comments, plus the constant names in scripts/. Seeded once from a tree a person had read, so only a NEW all-caps token has to be justified. A brand-shaped token is not here, so it fails.
